palm_face.selection: Positive hand-Z side toward the measured curled finger skin; all three vertices dominant hand_r. This is one actual surface face, not an average of the whole hand.

grip_target.method: Midpoint of chosen actual palm-face centroid and closest point on actual middle/ring distal skin triangle

shaft_axis_candidate.selection: PCA through four measured distal skin group centres, oriented pinky toward index; requires image review, not an observed grasp axis

temporary_attachment_candidate.correct_public_application: Set relative rotation from candidate quaternion, then read actual held world Grip and actual hand socket TransformLocation(hand-local target); one SetWorldLocation of their difference. Keep hand_r attachment and absolute scale .7. Read back relative TF; this numeric relative-translation estimate is offline, not an actual readback.

dimension_warning_measured.interpretation: These exterior widths exceed the selected local palm-to-distal-skin gap; translation/rotation may still penetrate the closed fingers. This one surface gap is not a complete maximal-inscribed grasp diameter. Do not change production scale from this probe alone.
